opening.argument: The presentation promotes joining Forsage through “100% profit sharing” and a “1 Time Investment” [1][2]. It also links enrolling another person to instant money in the speaker’s wallet, while describing earnings from up-line, down-line, and cross-line participation [3][4]. The visible “INSTANT MONEY” claim and branching participant diagrams reinforce that enrollment and tiered participation are central to the offer [5]. Together, these are the hallmarks of recruitment commissions and a tiered matrix. The record does not establish the investment amount, who receives a payment, actual returns, or any completed transaction, so it does not prove that money was paid or a particular loss occurred.
